description: This file is a shell script used for verifying the installation and version of CLI tools, particularly in the context of an OpenClaw project. It sources an external script 'version-parse.sh' and defines a function 'verify_installed_cli' that checks if a specified CLI tool is installed with the correct version, and confirms it can execute basic commands.

methods.name: verify_installed_cli
methods.description: Verifies if a package CLI is installed at the expected version, checks its command or entry point, and runs a basic help command to confirm operational status.
